title: Drive one prepared-begin settings-change test through the real project-settings update
outcome: At least one test drives a head in prepared-begin recovery through the real update_project_engram_settings path (src/session_crud.rs, around the settings reset that rebuilds EngramSessionState). It proves that the reset carries the ended window and drops the pending marker, and that a later Resume reports 'may have been sent' and sends nothing. Today a_settings_change_ends_a_pending_begins_claim_to_be_sent and a_settings_change_keeps_an_ended_window_and_drops_any_other_budget simulate the reset by hand, through take_engram_admission_budget_for_settings_reset, so a regression in the session_crud wiring would not be caught.
acceptance: Drive one prepared-begin settings-change test through the real project-settings update is done
